title: Germany — PEGIDA Movement 2014-16
description: Movimiento anti-islamización. Marchas semanales en Dresde. Polarización moderada pero persistente. Pico: 25k personas Feb 2015.
sources: DiW (Deutsches Institut für Wirtschaftsforschung): polarization data
data_notes: P represents polarization_index (units: index). Series reconstructed from published research sources (empirical_estimated). Observation operator H: std(opinion) / 1.0. At Tier 1 (< 500 observations), only aggregate parameters can be calibrated against this case; see docs/validation/PROMPT_CALIBRACION_EQUIPO_AGENTES.md.
observation_operator_description: Polarization index: P tracks the rise of anti-immigration sentiment via PEGIDA. Observation operator H: std(opinion_dimension) normalized by half-range.
